description: Computes one layer's style term from raw channel Gram matrices and their squared distance with the 1/(4*C^2*M^2) factor; caller combines weighted layers (Gatys et al., Methods Eqs. (3)-(5), paper.txt:121-152; src/topologies/implementations/losses/gram_loss.py:4-40).

examples.title: Train a student to match teacher feature Gram matrices

name: Gram loss

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts no additional parameters; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because feature maps are not indexed classes
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point prediction tensor shaped [B,C,H,W] with positive dimensions
parameters.reduction: none returns one loss per sample, mean averages the batch, or sum totals it (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point tensor with the same [B,C,H,W] shape, dtype, and device as the prediction
